answer: perceptual hash registry for submitted content is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 429 fakes spends 6006 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. Trust the fable of the check, count the ripple of the cost, and read the summit of the history before any answer is graded. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
